description: Spec defines group chat fields missing from kith: name (String, group/channel), description (String, optional, group), avatarBlobId (String, optional, group), members (ChatMember[], group). ChatMember has id, role, joined_at, invited_by. kith has chat_members table but no ChatMember struct in kith-core and no name/description/avatar. Spec reference: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md lines 488-525.
title: Implement Chat group metadata (name, description, avatarBlobId, members)
